schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The constraint corrosion detector — watches a declared set of constraints and catches narrowing without a ruling. A constraint that stopped constraining, and no ruling sits in the same act, is corrosion.
why: CLAUDE.md 'a deterministic red is fixed, or it carries a ruling from Akien — never a paragraph.' Drift with a ruling behind it is the system learning; drift without one is decay. The enforcement is one predicate over both: a constraint stopped constraining, and no ruling sits in the same act. The constraint_set.json is the declared scope — the predicate is only as good as the set it watches, and narrowing the set fires the check on itself (self-reference).
falsifier: A constraint is removed from constraint_set.json and no ruling covers the removal, or a constraint in the set is weakened and the corrosion sieve does not red.
learns: It does not learn — the constraint set is authored. The citation detector reads CairnCommons/decisions/ for confirmed rulings.
owner: TRANSITIONAL CO-LISTING (Akien, RULED 2026-09-06, ruling 2026-09-06-codemother-owns-the-care-of-the-code): codemother is the owner of the care of the code, and this component is one of the inspectors/gates that are hers. CC stays co-listed until codemother has (1) a hand — a shim verb that fires the harbor door as actor 'codemother', (2) her line up — inference_domain running in the rack so her trees and hex.local answer over the bus, and (3) a judgment — the designed check she runs before admitting a crossing. When those exist, CC leaves this list.
